contract_selection: Round previous high to whole Celsius, then move one Celsius degree in revision direction; convert to Fahrenheit, round to integer, and select its bracket. Both roundings use half away from zero.
future_quote_policy: Exact end-minute only; no forward fill. Keep missing observations explicit.
metric: Later ask minus initial ask, in cents per contract. Also report later bid minus initial ask as a spread diagnostic; neither is realized profit.
scope: Kalshi adaptation of the tweet entry rule on the existing paired city-day universe and 12-to-18 UTC run comparison. No settlement exit, portfolio, capital constraint, fees, or assumed fills. This previously analyzed period is not untouched evaluation.
